title: An animated title
summary: Bring a title in letter by letter with letter animators, keep it moving with a wave, and keep the text editable.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text: Letter animators move a text field's letters one by one while it stays text you can edit: type a new word and the animation follows.

steps.title: Open the Behaviors panel
steps.text: Choose Window > Behaviors if it is not showing. It lists what is on the selection and the settings of each.

steps.title: Cascade it in
steps.text: With text selected the button reads Add Animator. Click it and choose Cascade In.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Press Enter, or click the play button in the timeline header. Each letter slides in and fades up, a little after the one before.

steps.title: Keep it moving
steps.text: Add Wave too. Once in, the letters ride a wave for as long as the title shows.

steps.title: Change the words
steps.text: Press T for the Text tool, click in the title and change the words. Press Esc and play again: the new words animate the same way.

steps.title: Well done
steps.text:
You animated a title letter by letter and kept it editable.

Try Typewriter, Scramble or Animate Letters, whose range can move, turn, scale and fade any part of the text. Bake makes a text field of each letter, a frame each.
